verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party custom-telephony guide documents both paths in the story: elastic SIP trunking to your own provider, and importing numbers from Twilio, Telnyx and Vonage. It also describes the setup flow (set up a SIP trunk, point the number at it, import it to Retell), and imported numbers work with features like Send SMS. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of BYO carrier/PBX SIP trunking in practice.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Integrate Retell voice agents with your own telephony provider using elastic SIP trunking or imported numbers from Twilio, Telnyx, and Vonage.
You set up a SIP trunk, configure your number to point to it, and import that number to Retell.
This guide shows how to integrate Retell agents with your telephony provider and use your own numbers.
